test_title: PYST 23: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 7th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A certain sum amounts to Rs. 6655 at 10% p.a. in 3 years. The compound interest on the same sum will amount to Rs. x at 1.5 times the earlier rate in 2 years. If the interest is compounded annually in both cases, what is the value of x?
solution:
**Given:**

Amount(A) = Rs. 6655, Time(T) = 3 years

Rate(R) = 10%

**Formula used:**

Amount(A) = P(1 + R/100)T

Compound interest(CI) = A - P

**Calculation:**

6655 = P(1 + 10/100)³

⇒ 6655 = P(11/10)³

⇒ P = 6655 × 1000/1331

⇒ P = 5000

Principle(P) = Rs. 5000

According to question

New rate(R₁) = 1.5R = 15%

New time(T₁) = 2 years

A = 5000(1 + 15/100)²

⇒ 5000(115/100)²

⇒ 5000 × 13225/10000

 A = Rs. 6612.50

CI = x = 6612.5 - 5000 = 1612.50

**∴ The value of x is Rs. 1612.50**
